contract.description: Apply GLSL ES fragment shaders to images. u_resolution (vec2) is always available.

behavior.size_from_input: first input IMAGE width and height
behavior.size_custom: checked width and height are projected unchanged
behavior.uniform_order: autogrow inputs are ordered by numeric suffix and compacted to u_image0, u_float0, u_int0, u_bool0, and u_curve0 service slots
behavior.curves: raw CURVE points use source linear or monotone-cubic interpolation and 256 evenly spaced samples from 0 through 1
behavior.execution: one injected NativeShaderExecutor request owns GLSL ES compilation, uniforms, MRT, multipass execution, diagnostics, cancellation, and float readback
behavior.outputs: four canonical RGBA IMAGE handles; unused MRT slots are source-compatible black images
behavior.ui: transactionally prepared GLSLShader_input and GLSLShader_output temporary PNG references

failure.missing_image: invalid_node_inputs with At least one input image is required
failure.cancellation: execution_interrupted with no output handles or prepared previews
failure.partial_handle_publication: all already-published IMAGE handles and prepared previews are rolled back

behavior.recovery: a fresh attempt with current-generation IMAGE handles and an injected compatible shader service succeeds after invalid, cancelled, unavailable, or stale-handle failure
